content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-180. - I.R.C. Section R301.1, Application.
content.summary:
Section R301.1. Application,
is hereby amended by adding a second paragraph as follows:
"
R301.1. Application.
Design snow loads for this jurisdiction are: roof snow load = 30 psf (1.44 kN/m2);
                  ground snow load = 25 psf (1.2 kN/m2)."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
_____
